params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: A garage whose only open item is a transport waiting for it gets no daily mail. That transport is something the garage has to act on (finish the request, or agree to a price and pay), so it should be enough for the mail on its own.

## What happens

The daily worklist mail selects a dealer only when it has unfinished vehicles, Car-Passes about to expire, untreated leads, or a user with unread release notes (`DealerRepository::getAllWithWorklistItems`, R P1-2.11 and R P1-2.12). A dealer whose only open item is a transport waiting for it is not selected. The transport only shows up in the mail on days when something else is open as well. The garage in Portal mail:44 noticed exactly this.

Since #1077 the transport count holds only what waits for the garage (`Transport::WAITING_FOR_GARAGE_STATES`), so selecting on it no longer pulls in transports that are the office's to handle.

## Asked

Select a dealer for the daily mail when it has an open transport (`Dealer::OpenTransport`) as well. Who gets the line stays as it is: only a user who passes the transport gate, and a user with no line he can open gets no mail. Update R P1-2.11 and R P1-2.12.

Source: Portal mail:44 (follow-up to #1076).
params.title: Daily mail for a garage whose only open item is a transport waiting for it
